# hostwarden_user (Resource)

A Hostwarden user. Managing users requires the provider to authenticate as an administrator.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password, at least 8 characters. Changing it signs the user out everywhere.
- `role` (String) admin (everything) or readonly (can look, cannot change anything nor open consoles).
- `username` (String) User name: letters, digits and . _ @ - (max 64).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
